name: Bigger Crate
description: Carry 12 items at a time instead of 6.

name: Good Boots
description: Move 30% faster. Feels enormous once the shop gets big.

name: High Street Frontage
description: Move onto the high street. Twice the people walk past, and they were going shopping anyway.

name: Market Square
description: A corner on the square. Everyone in town crosses it at least once a week.

name: Retail Park Unit
description: Out of town, off the ring road, with a car park. Nobody walks past — they drive to you.

name: Till Supplier
description: A deal on registers. Every till you install costs 25% less.

name: Cold Chain Deal
description: The refrigeration people know you now. 20% off every freezer you build. Ice cream money.

name: Second Field
description: Clear the scrub behind the shop. Breaking new ground costs 20% less from here on.

name: Back Forty
description: Buy the strip along the fence line. 35% off every bed you dig.

name: Shelving Contract
description: A standing order with the shopfitter. Every shelf you build from now on is 15% cheaper.

name: Trade Account
description: Buy shelving at trade. 30% off every shelf you put down.

name: Side Extension
description: Buys the land west of the shop and pushes the building out three tiles. Since you can wall and floor a room yourself, what this really sells is room to do it in — the map only stretches as far as you own.

name: Back Extension
description: Three more tiles of land behind the shop, and the building grows into them. Deeper aisles, longer queues before anyone spills onto the street, and more ground you are allowed to build on.

name: Hire a Chef
description: Works the appliances: gathers ingredients, makes the products, shelves them.

name: Hire a Clerk
description: Mans the till and takes payment so shoppers stop walking out of the queue.

name: Hire a Farmhand
description: Plants, harvests and walks the produce to a shelf.

name: Hire a Shop Hand
description: Tills, deliveries and shelves — and picks the odd ripe plot when the shop is quiet.

name: Hire a Stocker
description: Buys wholesale and keeps the shelves full while you are out back.

name: Blender
description: Turns produce into salsa and smoothies.

name: Coffee Machine
description: Beans and milk in, a proper flat white out.

name: Deep Fryer
description: Adds a deep fryer to the shop floor.

name: Juicer
description: Adds a juicer to the shop floor.

name: Sandwich Press
description: Adds a sandwich press to the shop floor.

name: Soft-Serve Machine
description: Adds a soft-serve machine to the shop floor.

name: Toaster Oven
description: Bakes and toasts. Bread in, better bread out.
